claim: The hypothalamic preoptic area (POA) plays a critical role in social behavior.
source: Here, we investigate the cellular evolution of the hypothalamic preoptic area (POA), a brain region that plays a critical role in social behavior, across two sister species of deer mice (Peromyscus maniculatus and P. polionotus) with divergent social systems.
evidence: This is stated as established knowledge about the POA.
